title: Nuevo Laredo Women's Institute Offers Free Film Workshop for Women
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo's Municipal Women's Institute is inviting women to a free film workshop, 'Cámara y acción con mirada violeta,' running Nov. 9, 10, 11 and 13 at the Salón Palabra de Mujer.
content:
The Municipal Women's Institute (INMUJER) of Nuevo Laredo is inviting women across the city to a free film workshop, “Cámara y acción con mirada violeta: Cineminuto – Bironga Films,” according to CML Noticias.

The workshop will run Nov. 9, 10, 11 and 13, from 5 to 7 p.m., at the Salón Palabra de Mujer at INMUJER, located at Orizaba 3829 in the colonia México, according to the report.

Participants will learn audiovisual tools, develop their creativity and explore new ways to tell stories through the short-film cineminuto format, incorporating a gender perspective, according to CML Noticias.

The workshop aims to open spaces for women to express their ideas, experiences and points of view through film, while gaining knowledge they can apply to personal and creative projects, according to the report.

Admission is free, but space is limited and advance registration is required through the institute's online form, according to CML Noticias.

Sources: CML Noticias; Eleese Noticias.
